mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which lifts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC drops below 0.05 in walk-forward.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 5% indicates weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

failure_condition: 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% AND PAYEMS growth < 0.1pp over 3 months
